newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bull run seen taking a breather.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bull run seen taking a breather.

text.p: ** (0415 GMT) - Bombay stocks are expected to open
slightly lower Thursday after last-minute heavy
offloading pulled down stocks the previous day
** Shares seen in a technical correction after this week's
sizzling five percent rally pushes index to 33-mth high
** Focus continues on front-line stocks with strong market
** Market eyes election of leader in Prime Minister Inder
Kumar Gujral's party which is overshadowed by corruption
allegations and prospects of a bitter split in its ranks
